# Calculate the correlation between education expenditure and GDP for each country group
correlation_data = {}
for country_group in ['Sub-Saharan Africa', 'Lower middle income']:
    # Extract education expenditure and GDP data for the country group
    education_expenditure_group = education_expenditure_data.loc[country_group].dropna()
    gdp_group = gdp_data.loc[country_group].dropna()
    
    # Ensure the data is aligned by year
    common_years = education_expenditure_group.index.intersection(gdp_group.index)
    education_expenditure_group = education_expenditure_group[common_years]
    gdp_group = gdp_group[common_years]
    
    # Calculate the correlation
    correlation = education_expenditure_group.corrwith(gdp_group)
    correlation_data[country_group] = correlation

correlation_data
